**Current**
- Experts expect Smart, together with Thompson and VanVleet, to take most of the point guard minutes ahead of Reed Sheppard. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=1502), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1968), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1955))
- A note from 2026-10-12 says Smart has also started and outplayed Reed Sheppard. (fact, 2026-10-12; [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=1677))
- He is not in the projected starting five of VanVleet, Thompson, Durant, Smith and Sengun. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=328), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=357))
- Smart may lead the Houston bench in minutes. Ime Udoka coached him in Boston and values defense. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1276))
- He could become a streamer or an add when VanVleet sits. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1276))
- With our March 28 end date, Houston plays a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over weeks 19 to 21. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1970))
- Houston has only 14 back-to-backs this season. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2011))
- Smart joined the Rockets this offseason. Houston's guard rotation is crowded with Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Reed Sheppard and Bogdan Bogdanovic. (fact, 2026-09-15; [09-15](https://youtu.be/KPdD91Oo8-U?t=2090), [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=1659), [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=1091))
- Houston is predicted to win 54 games. The team is expected to play it safe in the regular season and not chase seeding. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1780))

**Durable**
- Smart gives his value in assists and steals and does not score much. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1330), stats)
- He is not a traditional point guard, but he can bring the ball up and run the offense. He takes good care of the ball. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=254), stats)
- He is still a very good defender. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=254))
- His shooting is a weak point. He is willing to shoot, but his FG% is low for a guard. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=324), stats)
- He gets hurt often. (fact, 2026-07-02; [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=1463), stats)

**Tags**
- Current: `new team` (Joined Houston this offseason), `minutes competition` (Crowded guard group with VanVleet, Thompson, Sheppard and Bogdanovic), `waiver watch` (Possible stream or add when VanVleet sits), `bad playoff schedule` (3-3-4, 10 games in weeks 19 to 21 with a March 28 end), `few back-to-backs` (14 back-to-backs), `winning team` (Predicted 54 wins)
- Durable: `elite defender` (Very good defender and a fit for Udoka's defense-first approach), `injury prone` (Described as hurt all the time)

**Note.** Smart is ranked 224 on Yahoo and 248 on ESPN, and both sites value him at 0 USD. That puts him well outside the 144 players drafted in our league, so do not draft him. His projected line has a weak FG% (39.6%), only 8.5 points and few rebounds, which leaves him a bench minutes player with steals, some threes and low turnovers. Early in the season, watch how many bench minutes Udoka gives him and pick him up on waivers when VanVleet misses games. His team's 10-game playoff schedule makes him less useful late in the season.
